summary: Steel tower reported in Oxford, CT in March 1929; Forest Lookouts lists it as removed and doubts the location; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists it as removed, with no date. A trail listing for Southford Falls State Park describes a retired fire tower, but no source connects that tower to this site.

events.note: March 1929 item quoted by Forest Lookouts (attributed to The Forest Worker): tenth steel observation tower of the Connecticut Department of Forestry, recently completed in Oxford; the same page notes the location may be wrong, so the item is not shown to refer to this lookout

corrections.why: The brief's agency field holds the start of a dated quotation rather than an agency name. The quoted March 1929 item names the Connecticut Department of Forestry.

notes_for_editor: Site status and location are unverified. Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed and flags the 1929 Oxford item as possibly the wrong location. A Hiking Project listing describes a retired, climbable fire tower in Southford Falls State Park (Southbury/Oxford area); no source ties it to Governors Hill, and the brief's coordinates were not checked against it. The FFLOS registration date (September 9, 2008, from the brief) did not appear in my reads, so it is not recorded here. Staffing, access and height were not found in any source read. Suggest checking the Southford Falls tower and the Oxford location before the status is changed.
